text: Thomas Midgley Junior had two big ideas. Idea one: add lead to petrol so engines stop knocking. To prove it was safe, he washed his hands in it in front of reporters. Then he quietly took a long holiday to recover from lead poisoning. Idea two: CFCs, the perfect gas for fridges. They also tore a hole in the ozone layer. Later, polio left him unable to walk, so he built a machine of ropes and pulleys to lift himself out of bed. In 1944, that machine killed him. One historian said he affected the atmosphere more than any other single organism in Earth's history.
